_comment: Paths of this machine. blur_data/scripts/dm_link.py links them into resources/. A relative local_root is relative to the repository; a relative local_path is relative to local_root, an absolute one is used as-is.

v2b.note: your own recordings: a nuScenes-style export (<scene>/v1.0-*/ tables plus sensor_data/); 'v2b' is the reader's name

v2b-blurred.note: a copy of the export above; blur-data-render.py rewrites its camera images

pp4av.note: huggingface.co/datasets/khaclinh/pp4av (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0): unzip data/images.zip and data/annotations.zip here, one folder per city

arcface.note: only for FM-Anonymize-Gen and its evaluation: InsightFace buffalo_l (det_10g.onnx, w600k_r50.onnx), non-commercial research only
